Issue reference: Fixes <PROJECT-ISSUE-NUMBER>

_Please include a summary of what the PR changes — what it fixes/introduces/improves/removes, and include any other necessary information for the reviewer. This can be a commit message, too._

Basic PR checklist:

- [ ] PR has a short description and the relevant issue is linked.
- [ ] Branch name references the issue number if applicable (e.g., `14-fix-stuff`).
- [ ] README / wiki updated if necessary.
- [ ] PR adheres to all points written [here](https://github.com/eos-applications/ew-edmt/wiki/Development-Guidelines#pr-checklist)
